beats.summary: Pam struggles with the principle of eating a cupcake that was laced by Todd Packer.

evidence.snippet: Pam: No, no. It's the principle of the thing.

beats.summary: Kevin pretends to choke on a cupcake and then claims it was fantastic.

evidence.snippet: Andy (exits office, chewing): Oh my god. I forgive him so much. Whoa, is he choking?
Kevin (after long choking and refusing help from Meredith): Oh, that was fantastic.

beats.summary: Dwight teaches Cameron how to milk a goat and warns about killer chickens.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Yes, very. You really need to stand back because these are killer chickens.
Dwight: Come here. Come on. Grab a teat with each hand. Sit down. There you go. Squeeze from top to bottom. Really pull. Use some muscle. Draw the milk out.

beats.summary: Office workers share stories about their strange experiences after eating the laced cupcakes.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Last night, I got out all of my old dolls and played with them on the living room floor. Then, I ordered ten American Girl outfits online.
Clark: I went Christmas caroling in March and I fertilized some bushes along the way.

beats.summary: Kevin and Andy share a close, emotional moment reflecting on their normal night after the cupcake incident.

evidence.snippet: Kevin (he and Andy embrace each other in tears): My night was just like that. Meaning normal.
Andy: Yeah. I didn't see you last night at all.

beats.summary: Todd Packer attempts to make amends by offering cupcakes to Darryl and Jim.

evidence.snippet: Todd Packer: So, that's it. I just wanted to make amends.
